# 端序转换辅助

> 头文件: `portfs/src/pfs_endian.h`
> HTML: [`index.html`](../../../.tmp/pfs-doxygen/html/index.html) (本地生成后可用)

端序转换与 buffer 读写辅助

## 函数

### `pfs_read_le16`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 LE 值; 与主机序无关

```c
(const uint8_t *p)
```
### `pfs_read_le32`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 LE 32 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(const uint8_t *p)
```
### `pfs_read_le64`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 LE 64 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(const uint8_t *p)
```
### `pfs_write_le16`

向 uint8_t buffer 写 LE 16 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v)
```
### `pfs_write_le32`

向 uint8_t buffer 写 LE 32 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v)
```
### `pfs_write_le64`

向 uint8_t buffer 写 LE 64 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v)
```
### `pfs_read_be16`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 BE 16 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(const uint8_t *p)
```
### `pfs_read_be32`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 BE 32 位值; 与主机序无关

```c
(const uint8_t *p)
```
### `pfs_read_be64`

从 uint8_t buffer 读 BE 64 位值; 与主机序无关

### `pfs_write_be16`

向 uint8_t buffer 写 BE 16 位值; 与主机序无关

### `pfs_write_be32`

向 uint8_t buffer 写 BE 32 位值; 与主机序无关

### `pfs_write_be64`
